opening.text: 早上好，我是鲸鱼娘，今天是10月15日。
opening.en: Good morning, I'm Whale Girl. Today is October 15.
opening.tts: 早上好，我是鲸鱼娘，今天是十月十五日。

opening.text: 今天说五件事：Anthropic 在新加坡开办公室，谷歌做设备端反诈，Google Earth AI 升级地理空间代理，苹果研究三模态扩散和语音混语检测。
opening.en: Five stories today: Anthropic opens in Singapore, Google builds on-device scam detection, Google Earth AI upgrades its geospatial agent, and Apple studies tri-modal diffusion and code-switching detection.

news.headline: Anthropic 新加坡开办公室
news.rundown_key: Anthropic 在新加坡开办公室

lines.text: 第一件，Anthropic 10月14日宣布，在新加坡开设办公室，这是它在亚太地区的第五个办公室。
lines.en: First, Anthropic announced on October 14 that it opened an office in Singapore, its fifth office in the Asia-Pacific region.

lines.text: 同时，Anthropic 和新加坡数字发展及信息部签了一份合作备忘录。
lines.en: At the same time, Anthropic and Singapore's Ministry of Digital Development and Information signed a memorandum.

lines.text: 合作范围包括 AI 安全、安保和模型评估。
lines.en: The cooperation covers AI safety, security and model evaluation.

lines.text: 双方还计划做技术交流，涉及测试标准和事故响应，也分享研究和数据。
lines.en: They also plan technical exchanges on testing standards and incident response, and sharing research and data.

lines.text: Anthropic 还说会探索帮助中小企业和政府人员更负责任地用 AI 的方式。
lines.en: Anthropic also says it will explore ways to help small businesses and public officers adopt AI responsibly.

lines.en: Anthropic says Singapore, on Claude usage relative to population, ranks second among 121 countries, nearly six times its expected level.

news.headline: 谷歌设备端反诈模型
news.vhook: 谷歌和政府都读不了聊天

lines.text: 第二件，Google DeepMind 和新加坡 GovTech 合作，做了一个设备端的诈骗对话检测模型。
lines.en: Second, Google DeepMind and Singapore's GovTech built an on-device model for detecting scam conversations.

lines.text: 谷歌说，诈骗占新加坡报案数量的一半以上，自2019年以来造成的损失超过40亿新加坡元。
lines.en: Google says scams make up more than half of Singapore's reported crimes, with losses since 2019 topping 4 billion Singapore dollars.

lines.text: 他们把轻量级 Gemma 模型用本地诈骗对话微调，覆盖冒充政府机构、银行和本地人物等套路。
lines.en: They fine-tuned a lightweight Gemma model on local scam conversations, including impersonation of public institutions, banks and local figures.

lines.text: 模型直接在手机上分析对话模式，发现可能的操纵意图后，在设备上实时提醒用户暂停。
lines.en: The model analyzes conversation patterns on the phone and gives a real-time warning on the device when it detects possible manipulation.

lines.text: 谷歌和新加坡政府都不能读取聊天内容，模型只有在用户同意、并且应用条款允许时才接入。
lines.en: Google and the Singapore Government cannot read the chats; the model works only with user consent and the application's terms allowing access.

lines.text: 实现上用了两阶段流程，先看较小的上下文，再用微调后的 Gemma 检查更大的对话片段。
lines.en: The system uses two stages: a small context check first, followed by the fine-tuned Gemma model examining a larger conversation snapshot.

lines.text: 原文称应用里的推广会分阶段进行，也提到在手机上跑分类器要特别注意电量。
lines.en: The post says rollout in the app will be phased, and notes that battery use needs special attention when running a classifier on a phone.

news.headline: Google Earth AI 地理代理
news.rundown_key: Google Earth AI 升级地理空间代理
news.vhook: 从地图问答到多步分析

lines.text: 第三件，Google Research 发布新技术报告，介绍升级后的地理空间推理代理。
lines.en: Third, Google Research published a technical report on an upgraded geospatial reasoning agent.

lines.text: 它把 Gemini 接到 WeatherNext、洪水预测、人口动态、卫星遥感和 Google Earth Engine 等工具上。
lines.en: It connects Gemini to WeatherNext, flood forecasting, population dynamics, satellite remote sensing and Google Earth Engine tools.

lines.text: 用户提问后，代理先制定多步计划，再选择数据集和模型，在独立工作区处理大规模地图数据。
lines.en: After a question, the agent plans a multi-step workflow, selects datasets and models, and processes large map data in a separate workspace.

lines.text: 这次新增了两个评测基准：GeoKTools 和 GeoExpertQueries，一共对比四种代理配置。
lines.en: The work adds two benchmarks, GeoKTools and GeoExpertQueries, and compares four agent configurations.

lines.text: Google 还扩大了 Ask Google Earth 实验性深度分析和 Agent-to-Agent API 的早期试用。
lines.en: Google is also expanding Ask Google Earth experimental deep analysis and early access to the Agent-to-Agent API.
cuts: Google 还扩大了
Google is also expanding
Ask Google Earth 实验性深度分析
Ask Google Earth experimental deep analysis

lines.text: 合作测试里，有机构用它分析14条历史飓风路径，几分钟完成原本要人工做几天的筛查。
lines.en: In partner testing, one organization analyzed 14 historical cyclone paths in minutes instead of days of manual screening.

lines.text: 但官方明确提醒，部分分数来自自动评分器，结果更像专家的第一稿，不是最终答案。
lines.en: Google explicitly warns that some scores come from an autorater, so the output is a strong first draft rather than a final answer.

news.headline: 苹果三模态扩散模型
news.vhook: 文本、图像和音频一起预训练
points: 文本图像音频都能生成

lines.text: 第四件，苹果研究团队公布三模态掩码扩散模型，训练数据同时包含文本、图文和音频文本。
lines.en: Fourth, Apple's research team presented a tri-modal masked diffusion model trained on text, image-text and audio-text data.

lines.text: 论文说，这是第一个从零开始预训练的三模态 Masked Diffusion Model。
lines.en: The paper says this is the first tri-modal Masked Diffusion Model pretrained from scratch.
cuts: 论文说，这是第一个从零开始预训练的三模态
The paper says this is the first tri-modal

lines.text: 作者系统分析了多模态缩放规律、模态混合比例、噪声日程和批量大小。
lines.en: The authors systematically analyze multimodal scaling laws, modality mixing ratios, noise schedules and batch size.

lines.text: 他们还提出一种基于随机微分方程的重参数化，把物理批量大小和逻辑批量大小解耦。
lines.en: They also propose a stochastic-differential-equation reparameterization that decouples physical and logical batch size.

lines.text: 初步统一模型的规模是3B，使用了6.4万亿 token，在文本生成、文生图和文生音频任务上都给出结果。
lines.en: The preliminary unified model has 3B parameters and uses 6.4 trillion tokens, with results in text generation, text-to-image and text-to-speech tasks.
cuts: 使用了6.4万亿 token，
and uses 6.4 trillion tokens,

lines.text: 这是一项开放研究和系统分析，不等于苹果已经发布了可直接使用的产品模型。
lines.en: This is an open research study and systematic analysis, not a product model that Apple has released for direct use.

news.headline: 苹果检测语音混语
news.rundown_key: 苹果研究语音混语检测
news.vhook: 不用先转写就能找混语

lines.text: 第五件，苹果提出一种直接从语音里找混语句子的轻量方法，不必先把整段音频转成文字。
lines.en: Fifth, Apple proposed a lightweight way to detect code-switching directly from speech.

lines.text: 这里的混语，是一句话里交替使用两种语言，常见于多语言对话。
lines.en: Code-switching means alternating between two languages in one utterance, common in multilingual conversations.

lines.text: 方法从预训练语音编码器里找出对某种语言敏感的隐藏维度，再聚合成逐帧的混语预测。
lines.en: The method finds language-selective hidden dimensions in a pretrained speech encoder and aggregates frame-level activations into a prediction.

lines.text: 在 CS-FLEURS 数据集的14种语言对上，Whisper-small 编码器的平均 F1 是0.798。
lines.en: Across CS-FLEURS's 14 language pairs, the Whisper-small encoder reached a mean F1 of 0.798.
cuts: 在 CS-FLEURS 数据集的14种语言对上，
Across CS-FLEURS's 14 language pairs,

lines.text: 这个分数高于 CNN 的0.776，也高于 HuBERT 线性基线的0.751。
lines.en: That is higher than 0.776 for a CNN and 0.751 for a HuBERT linear baseline.

lines.text: 意义在于，数据团队可以先从大规模语音库里筛出混语音频，再补充多语言训练数据。
lines.en: The idea is to help data teams find code-switching audio in large speech collections and build more representative multilingual training data.

lines.text: 论文展示的是数据筛选工具，不是已经解决混语识别的完整语音助手。
lines.en: The paper presents a data-selection tool, not a complete speech assistant that has solved code-switching recognition.

closing.text: 今天就这些，来源都在简介里。
closing.en: That's all for today. Sources are in the description.
